desc: Read input, transpose the grid when H > W (so the maintained dimension is ≤ min(H,W) ≤ ~447), and remap directions U↔L, D↔R accordingly; store the grid column-major.
Precompute prefix DP vectors pr[w][h] (path products from (1,1) to (h,w)) and suffix DP vectors sf[w][h] (path products from (h,w) to (H,W)) in O(HW).

For each query, advance the token, then (if the value actually changes) update the running answer by (new−old)·p·g mod 998244353, where p = prefix-sum excluding the cell (pr[c][r-1] + pr[c-1][r]) and g = suffix-sum excluding the cell (sf[c][r]).

On a horizontal move, recompute the full destination column vector in the direction of travel (pr on right move, sf on left move); on a value change, repair only the affected rows of that column (pr rows ≥ r, sf rows < r). Vertical moves require no vector recomputation.
Emit the maintained answer after each change; verified on both public samples (456/666/822 and 299123226/548055393/810247224/876210800/773990840/506814544).
